content.title: THE MINERAL THAT DECIDES IF YOU WAKE UP {{TIRED}} OR SHARP
facts: **Copper** (Energy Spark Plug) — Cashews | Dark Chocolate | Shiitake Mushrooms | Chickpeas
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Mussels | Pineapple | Brown Rice | Pecans
**Selenium** (Thyroid Guardian) — Brazil Nuts | Tuna | Eggs Yolks | Sunflower Seeds
**Magnesium** (Nervous System Calmer) — Cashews | Black Beans | Swiss Chard | Tofu
**Calcium** (Heartbeat Regulator) — Sardines with Bones | Bok Choy | Almonds | Yogurt
**Iron** (Oxygen Carrier) — Beef Liver | Spinach | Pumpkin Seeds | Quinoa
**Iodine** (Metabolism Switch) — Seaweed | Cod | Dairy | Iodized Salt
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Copper doesn't get much attention, but it's what actually helps your body turn iron into usable energy — without enough of it, you can eat all the iron-rich foods you want and still feel drained. Manganese quietly works behind the scenes to activate the enzymes that build and repair your bones and cartilage, so a deficiency shows up as achy joints long before you'd think to blame your diet. And selenium is one of the few minerals your thyroid needs directly to convert its hormones into the active form your cells can actually use, which is why low selenium is so often tied to sluggish metabolism and constant fatigue. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.
